scientific_integrity: Universal distributional and convex risk claims proved analytically; finite numerical checks support, not replace, proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-column Nyström on real SPD 2-by-2 matrices; not comparable at equal arithmetic cost; no higher-rank or floating-point result. Novelty is a best-knowledge assessment.
title: The real-complex Gaussian risk-order crossover in one-column Nyström
